name: refrigeration_cycle_simple_compressor
title: Refrigeration cycle with a simple compressor model
summary: Vapour-compression refrigeration cycle driven by a reciprocating compressor described by a clearance-volume volumetric efficiency and a linear loss model; compares R22, R134a and propane.

origin.course: Machines et systèmes thermiques (ULiège), exercise session 1, exercise 3

verification.reference: EES parametric table stored in the source file (3 runs: R22, R134a, Propane) for the faithful import; CoolSolve example compressor_refrigeration_simple for the corrected model
verification.notes: Faithful import vs EES: R134a 0.06 %, propane 0.3 %, R22 1.4 % (EES 7.4 vs CoolProp R22 properties). Corrected model vs CoolSolve example: < 0.02 %.

related_external: CoolSolve examples/compressor_refrigeration_simple.eescode (same exercise, R22 and R134a computed side by side)

history.action: added (pilot model of the library methodology)
